decisions.question: Freeze the model's cross-contract identity and fence mapping before E-FHAR2-101.
decisions.current_rule: OR-018/019 and E-FHAR2-101 already select the boundary; six mappings remain unproved, not a new architecture choice.
options: One aggregate plus explicit adapter proof obligations (recommended): smallest reviewable state space; cannot claim broker/runtime proof.
Include bounded broker cursor/credit state now: stronger interaction coverage with larger state space.
decisions.recommendation: Keep the existing finite scope; write a closed projection for effect/packet/goal/plan identities, distinct fence domains and ambiguity; model broker RESET as an adapter obligation unless a counterexample couples it to canonical append.
decisions.default_vs_configuration: proposed fixed model boundary; future exploration bounds configurable
decisions.falsifier: A trace admits a stale result, ambiguous retry, future PAUSE permission, or unbound writer.
decisions.blocked: Formal-model freeze; no M1 repair is authorized.
decisions.uncertainty: Proposal only; no Owner answer or runtime/performance outcome is supplied.

decisions.question: Define the minimum contract for a governed interactive route and the scope of native-loop work.
decisions.current_rule: OR-019 permits optional upstream engines; universal native-feature parity and a complete native loop remain unselected.
options: Typed governed routes plus explicitly restricted native terminal sessions (recommended): preserves capability differences and upfront limits.
Only engines passing the full mediation floor: smaller route catalog, stronger uniform guarantees.
Develop a complete native loop first: more ownership and BYOK freedom, higher implementation and evaluation cost.
decisions.recommendation: One Recursion CLI and canonical command bus; typed engine adapters with versioned optional extensions. Use BYOK for a later native-loop comparator. Refuse any work whose required fence cannot be enforced at the actual resource.
decisions.default_vs_configuration: proposed common base; optional capabilities and engine choice configurable
decisions.falsifier: A supposedly governed route performs an effect outside its declared mediation/containment boundary.
decisions.blocked: Interactive adapter implementation and claims of Recursion command parity.
decisions.uncertainty: Proposal only; no Owner answer or runtime/performance outcome is supplied.

decisions.question: Choose the public authentication promise for Recursion's native and delegated modes.
decisions.current_rule: Technical authentication, usage entitlement and distribution are independent; Owner wants Recursion UX with Claude Code where required.
options: Route-specific BYOK and user-authenticated upstream binaries (recommended): honest limits, additional setup surfaces.
BYOK-only initial public support: simpler terms and usage accounting; excludes subscription-driven workflow.
Promise broad subscription reuse only after explicit provider agreements: larger market scope with unresolved prerequisites.
decisions.recommendation: Keep Claude SDK/API and unmodified Claude Code sessions separate. Let the upstream binary conduct its own sign-in; no token interception or pooled credentials. Codex login capability does not establish a universal third-party OAuth right.
decisions.default_vs_configuration: proposed public wording; user selects eligible route
decisions.falsifier: A required Recursion feature needs unsupported login reuse, binary modification or usage intermediation.
decisions.blocked: Public subscription support wording and redistribution packaging, not formal-model work.
decisions.uncertainty: Proposal only; no Owner answer or runtime/performance outcome is supplied.

decisions.question: Whether to add an optional agent-assisted /setup after deterministic bootstrap.
decisions.current_rule: CLI already mandates schema-driven zero-model setup; agent assistance is new and unproved.
options: Deterministic setup plus optional proposal-only assistant (recommended): offline and first-auth recovery remain possible.
Deterministic setup only for v3.0: lower complexity and support burden.
decisions.recommendation: Keep credential entry in protected provider/OS flows and outside prompts. Assistant may explain presets and propose a scoped diff; validation, explicit application and rollback remain deterministic.
decisions.falsifier: A fresh offline installation needs a model to recover or an assistant sees a credential.
decisions.uncertainty: Proposal only; no Owner answer or runtime/performance outcome is supplied.

decisions.question: Choose provisional compaction and cache-refresh defaults pending measurements.
decisions.current_rule: CONTEXT already has capsules, fidelity checks and one compaction owner; hybrid benefit and refresh savings remain hypotheses.
options: Event-driven continuation, route-aware compaction, no model keepalive (recommended): avoids speculative idle spend.
Opt-in provider-specific refresh only after total-cost trials: possible latency savings, additional quota and privacy cost.
decisions.recommendation: Use hard non-droppable control state and fidelity refusal. Separate capacity, price threshold and cache retention. Require experiment.foundation.cache before enabling periodic model refresh; preserve native compaction boundaries through epoch-bound ownership.
decisions.default_vs_configuration: no model keepalive proposed default; thresholds and eligible retention configurable
decisions.falsifier: Refresh costs more per successful task, or a summary loses authority/evidence despite a high cache-hit rate.
decisions.blocked: Optimization defaults and claimed savings; capsule contract already stands.
decisions.uncertainty: Proposal only; no Owner answer or runtime/performance outcome is supplied.

decisions.question: Set the first remote deployment authority domain.
decisions.current_rule: Single-authority integrity is specified; single-user multi-node does not provide hosted tenant isolation.
options: One Owner/authority domain across enrolled nodes (recommended): test fencing and partitions before tenancy.
Organization-operated instance next: requires identity/role and audit contracts.
Hosted multi-tenant service: defer until isolated authorities, quotas, secrets and support obligations are designed.
decisions.recommendation: Keep client, coordinator, executor, engine, inference provider and account pool separate. One canonical writer per aggregate, explicit enrollment/revocation, manifest-first artifacts and reconnect revalidation; disconnected work cannot publish or widen authority.
decisions.default_vs_configuration: one authority domain proposed first; topology/locality configurable
decisions.falsifier: A disconnected or replaced node commits canonical state or publishes without fresh authority.
decisions.blocked: Remote runtime construction and organization/hosted scope; OR-015 still blocked.
decisions.uncertainty: Proposal only; no Owner answer or runtime/performance outcome is supplied.

decisions.question: Choose an initial evaluation profile for model allocation without turning models into authority roles.
decisions.current_rule: Head/ARM/worker and direct Owner-to-ARM interaction are accepted; model ladder efficiency is unproved.
options: Evaluate single agent, simple delegation, all-frontier and mixed fleet equally (recommended): evidence before policy.
Start with all-frontier as a temporary quality baseline: higher included-capacity pressure, easier attribution.
decisions.recommendation: Escalate on bounded evidence of difficulty, novelty or failure. Model replacement retains role and scope; permission escalation and lease replacement require separate transitions. Deterministic status heartbeats do not imply continuous model thought.
decisions.default_vs_configuration: evaluation treatments configurable; authority invariants fixed
decisions.falsifier: Mixed routing raises failure/review cost at equal budget or escalation widens authority.
decisions.blocked: Optimization profile, not accepted executive hierarchy.
decisions.uncertainty: Proposal only; no Owner answer or runtime/performance outcome is supplied.

decisions.question: Choose the adapter support window and emergency update admission policy.
decisions.current_rule: Pinned typed adapters exist as direction; unchanged protocol names do not prove unchanged behavior.
options: Current certified build plus one prior certified build (recommended proposal): bounded maintenance and a rollback target.
Only one certified build: lower maintenance, more disruptive emergency replacement.
Wider version ranges: easier adoption, much larger replay and security burden.
decisions.recommendation: Discover releases without auto-activating them. Diff source/schema/default tools/terms, stage with recorded digests, run synthetic transcripts and failure probes, quarantine discrepancies, explicitly promote at route-epoch boundaries; emergencies may disable admission while evidence is gathered.
decisions.default_vs_configuration: support-window proposal; update channel configurable, evidence gates fixed
decisions.falsifier: A build passes version negotiation but changes permission/tool/replay semantics undetected.
decisions.blocked: Public compatibility window and automatic update implementation.
decisions.uncertainty: Proposal only; no Owner answer or runtime/performance outcome is supplied.

decisions.question: Set the initial upstream command/plugin import depth.
decisions.current_rule: Plugin grants are independent and fenced; upstream commands cannot inherit authority through origin.
options: Schema-declared command adapters only (recommended): namespace and argument checks; unsupported features explicit.
Also execute upstream plugin environments: greater compatibility with a larger grant and dependency surface.
decisions.recommendation: Use separate provider, engine and Recursion plugin manifests. Reserve core commands, namespace imported aliases, expose translation losses and validate arguments/grants before dispatch. Removal must preserve canonical boot/recovery.
decisions.default_vs_configuration: minimal bridge proposed first; optional adapters configurable
decisions.falsifier: An imported command shadows a core command or a disabled plugin contributes authority or unavoidable idle work.
decisions.blocked: Advanced compatibility import; existing independent grant rules remain.
decisions.uncertainty: Proposal only; no Owner answer or runtime/performance outcome is supplied.

decisions.question: Select the first external learning cohort after Lucas-first validation.
decisions.current_rule: Lucas-first is accepted. Three-audience ambition supplies no market-demand or enterprise willingness-to-pay evidence.
options: Developers/power users first (recommended): bounded repository workflows and diagnosable failures.
Casual users first: earlier setup/comprehension feedback, higher support and recovery demands.
Organization pilots first: audit/identity feedback, slower procurement and broader requirements.
decisions.recommendation: Keep one product with optional profiles. First validate a small bounded repository task, interruption/recovery and cost comprehension; test novice setup separately. Defer hosted tenancy, commercial tiers and graphical/media extensions.
decisions.default_vs_configuration: Lucas-first fixed; proposed next cohort and optional profiles
decisions.falsifier: Target users cannot finish/recover the task or understand cost and authority without repeated expert help.
decisions.blocked: External cohort and adoption claims; no change to near-term construction order.
decisions.uncertainty: Proposal only; no Owner answer or runtime/performance outcome is supplied.

finalization: A later GRILLME session records each exact Owner answer via private intent reference, updates status and affected canonical documents, checks cross-decision consistency, and compiles an accepted versioned GoalSpec plus construction DAG. Silence is not acceptance.
